# Pure Writer

> Pure Writer (纯纯写作 in Simplified Chinese, 純純寫作 in Traditional Chinese, 純純執筆 in Japanese) is a fast plain text editor you can trust, with History, cloud sync and backups, layers of protection against losing your work, and many thoughtful writing aids. It is available for Android, iPhone and iPad, with a desktop version for Windows and macOS.

Pure Writer is a text editor for writing and organizing your own text. It does not offer books, magazines or other reading content, and it has no community, feed or publishing platform. What you write is never made public or shown to anyone else. Documents are stored on your device, backups and sync go only to your own iCloud or cloud drive, and Pure Writer's servers do not store your writing.

Pure Writer for iOS requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later. Every feature can be tried free for 7 days; afterwards a monthly subscription, a yearly subscription or a lifetime membership unlocks everything.
